about.intro_content: Prof. De-Sen Wan is Chief Specialist and founding leader of the colorectal cancer multidisciplinary team (MDT) at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center (SYSUCC), Guangzhou, which he established in 1998, one of the earliest such models in China.
about.detailed_content: Prof. Wan pioneered strategies to prevent liver metastases after colorectal cancer surgery, including 5-FU based intraoperative chemotherapy and postoperative intra-portal vein infusion. He established the CRC Liver Metastasis Group of the Chinese Anti-Cancer Association and led one of the earliest colorectal cancer screening programmes in China. He also founded China's first enterostomal therapist (ET) nurse training school, now the country's leading ET nurse training base. His treatment protocols are used as reference material for Chinese medical students.

faq.section_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Prof. De-Sen Wan

items.question: Does Prof. De-Sen Wan accept international patients?
items.answer: CancerFax can coordinate medical report review and consultation support for international patients seeking an opinion related to colorectal cancer at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center, subject to hospital availability and case acceptance.

items.question: What is Prof. Wan's area of specialisation?
items.answer: Prof. Wan specialises in multidisciplinary treatment of colorectal cancer, with a particular focus on preventing and managing liver metastases after surgery.

items.question: How can I request a consultation or second opinion?
items.answer: Submit your medical reports through CancerFax. The CancerFax team reviews the documents, prepares the case for submission, and coordinates next steps with SYSUCC's International Medical Center, subject to availability.

items.question: How does Prof. Wan help prevent liver metastasis after colorectal surgery?
items.answer: Prof. Wan pioneered intraoperative and postoperative 5-FU based chemotherapy delivery methods specifically designed to reduce the risk of liver metastasis following colorectal cancer surgery.

items.question: What is distinctive about SYSUCC's colorectal cancer programme?
items.answer: Prof. Wan founded SYSUCC's colorectal cancer multidisciplinary team in 1998, one of the earliest such models in China, along with the country's first enterostomal therapist nurse training school.
